-- Module:WorldEventTimetable
-- Builds the World Events timetable of Template:WorldEventTimetable from Module:WorldEventData.
-- Daily events go in seven day columns, game time events get their own panel (they repeat every 4 real hours).
-- The page is built in server time (New York), the script in MediaWiki:Common.js moves everything to the reader's
-- time zone. Without the script the readers see the server times and the game time hours.
local p = {}

local data = require('Module:WorldEventData')

local DAYS = { 'MON', 'TUE', 'WED', 'THU', 'FRI', 'SAT', 'SUN' }
local DAYKEY = { Mon = 0, Tue = 1, Wed = 2, Thu = 3, Fri = 4, Sat = 5, Sun = 6 }

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function minutes(hhmm)
	local h, m = tostring(hhmm):match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
	if not h then return nil end
	return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local function clock(min)
	return string.format('%02d:%02d', math.floor(min / 60), min % 60)
end

local function lasts(min)
	if not min then return nil end
	if min % 60 == 0 then return math.floor(min / 60) .. ' h' end
	if min > 60 then return math.floor(min / 60) .. ' h ' .. (min % 60) .. ' min' end
	return min .. ' min'
end

-- a name, each part links to its page when that page exists (no red links)
local exists = {}
local function pageExists(page)
	if exists[page] == nil then
		local t = mw.title.new(page)
		exists[page] = (t and t.exists) and true or false
	end
	return exists[page]
end

local function nameHtml(ev)
	if not ev.parts then return esc(ev.name) end
	local out = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(ev.parts) do
		if part[2] and (part[3] or pageExists(part[2])) then
			out[#out + 1] = '[[' .. part[2] .. '|' .. esc(part[1]) .. ']]'
		else
			out[#out + 1] = esc(part[1])
		end
	end
	return table.concat(out, ' / ')
end

local function icon(ev, size)
	local box = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('wev-ico')
	box:wikitext('[[File:' .. ev.icon .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=|alt=' .. esc(ev.name) .. ']]')
	return box
end

-- the anchor of the game clock (written by the sync bot), nil when the page does not exist yet
local function anchor()
	local ok, a = pcall(require, 'Module:GameTimeData')
	if ok and type(a) == 'table' and a.utc and a.gt then return a end
	return nil
end

function p.main(frame)
	local a = frame.args
	local layout = trim(a.layout):lower()
	if layout ~= 'week' and layout ~= 'agenda' then layout = 'auto' end
	local header = trim(a.header):lower() ~= 'no'
	local showGame = trim(a.gametime):lower() ~= 'no'
	local showDaily = trim(a.daily):lower() ~= 'no'
	local showPanel = trim(a.trader):lower() ~= 'no'

	local byDay = {}
	for d = 0, 6 do byDay[d] = {} end
	for _, s in ipairs(data.daily) do
		local ev = data.events[s[1]]
		local min = minutes(s[3])
		if ev and min and not ev.panel then
			if s[2] == 'Daily' then
				for d = 0, 6 do table.insert(byDay[d], { day = d, min = min, ev = ev }) end
			elseif DAYKEY[s[2]] then
				table.insert(byDay[DAYKEY[s[2]]], { day = DAYKEY[s[2]], min = min, ev = ev })
			end
		end
	end

	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('wev wev-' .. layout)
	local anc = anchor()
	if anc then
		root:attr('data-anchor-utc', anc.utc):attr('data-anchor-gt', anc.gt):attr('data-rate', anc.rate or 6)
	end

	if header then
		local top = root:tag('div'):addClass('wev-top')
		top:tag('div'):addClass('wev-gclock')
		local tz = top:tag('div'):addClass('wev-tz')
		tz:tag('span'):addClass('wev-tzlabel'):wikitext('Time zone')
		tz:tag('span'):addClass('wev-tzname'):wikitext('Server time (New York)')
	end

	if showDaily then
		local days = root:tag('div'):addClass('wev-days')
		for d = 0, 6 do
			local col = days:tag('div'):addClass('wev-day')
			local head = col:tag('div'):addClass('wev-dayhead')
			head:tag('span'):wikitext(DAYS[d + 1])
			head:tag('span'):addClass('wev-today'):wikitext('TODAY')
			local list = col:tag('div'):addClass('wev-events')
			table.sort(byDay[d], function(x, y)
				if x.min ~= y.min then return x.min < y.min end
				return x.ev.name < y.ev.name
			end)
			for _, s in ipairs(byDay[d]) do
				local ev = list:tag('div')
					:addClass('wev-ev wev-c-' .. s.ev.cls)
					:attr('data-day', s.day):attr('data-min', s.min)
				ev:tag('span'):addClass('wev-time'):wikitext(clock(s.min))
				ev:node(icon(s.ev, 32))
				local text = ev:tag('span'):addClass('wev-text')
				text:tag('span'):addClass('wev-name'):wikitext(nameHtml(s.ev))
				if s.ev.duration then text:tag('span'):addClass('wev-sub'):wikitext(esc(lasts(s.ev.duration))) end
				text:tag('span'):addClass('wev-nexttag'):wikitext('NEXT')
			end
		end
	end

	if showPanel then
		local ids = {}
		for id, ev in pairs(data.events) do
			if ev.panel then ids[#ids + 1] = id end
		end
		table.sort(ids)
		for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
			local ev = data.events[id]
			local slots, times = {}, {}
			for _, s in ipairs(data.daily) do
				if s[1] == id then
					slots[#slots + 1] = s[2] .. '|' .. s[3]
					if s[2] == 'Daily' then times[#times + 1] = s[3] end
				end
			end
			if #slots > 0 then
				table.sort(times)
				local card = root:tag('div'):addClass('wev-tr wev-c-' .. ev.cls)
					:attr('data-slots', table.concat(slots, ';')):attr('data-dur', ev.duration or 0)
				local top = card:tag('div'):addClass('wev-trtop')
				top:node(icon(ev, 36))
				local text = top:tag('span'):addClass('wev-text')
				text:tag('span'):addClass('wev-name'):wikitext(nameHtml(ev))
				local gap = math.floor(1440 / #slots)
				local sub = 'Every ' .. lasts(gap)
				if ev.duration and gap > ev.duration then
					sub = 'Up ' .. lasts(ev.duration) .. ', gone ' .. lasts(gap - ev.duration) .. ', on repeat'
				end
				text:tag('span'):addClass('wev-sub'):wikitext(esc(sub))
				top:tag('span'):addClass('wev-trstatus')
				local chips = card:tag('div'):addClass('wev-chips')
				for _, tm in ipairs(times) do chips:tag('span'):addClass('wev-chip'):wikitext(tm) end
			end
		end
	end

	if showGame then
		local gt = root:tag('div'):addClass('wev-gt')
		local gh = gt:tag('div'):addClass('wev-gthead')
		gh:tag('span'):addClass('wev-gttitle'):wikitext('Game time events')
		gh:tag('span'):addClass('wev-gtnote'):wikitext('In-game time runs 6 times faster, so each of these happens every 4 hours. Showing the next 24 hours.')
		local cards = gt:tag('div'):addClass('wev-gcards')
		for _, s in ipairs(data.gametime) do
			local ev = data.events[s[1]]
			if ev then
				local c = cards:tag('div'):addClass('wev-gc wev-c-' .. ev.cls):attr('data-hour', s[2])
				local top = c:tag('div'):addClass('wev-gctop')
				top:node(icon(ev, 36))
				local text = top:tag('span'):addClass('wev-text')
				text:tag('span'):addClass('wev-name'):wikitext(nameHtml(ev))
				text:tag('span'):addClass('wev-sub'):wikitext(string.format('%02d:00 GT', s[2]))
				c:tag('div'):addClass('wev-chips'):wikitext('<span class="wev-chipnone">every 4 hours</span>')
			end
		end
	end

	if header then
		root:tag('div'):addClass('wev-note'):wikitext('Times adjust to your time zone. Without scripts they show server time (New York).')
	end

	return tostring(root)
end

return p
